title: Answers the day-3 check-in once, then goes quiet: two daily texts, a second check-in, then silence
origin: Issue #41 (daily nudges never stop after one reply to the day-3 check-in)

history.text: Hey Maya! Ten pages of Dune on the couch at 7 tonight. Ready?
Maya, two nights slipped. Forget the ten: just open Dune tonight and read one page. What's getting in the way?

plan.reason: Ten pages a night builds the habit without eating your evening.

whatWentWrong: Before #41, one reply to the day-3 check-in meant one text a day forever.
shouldHaveHappened: Day 1 (18:50): the honest day-3 check-in. Maya answers "yeah yeah" and ZOH replies briefly, without guilt. Then she says nothing more: the next day and the day after each get one text at about 18:50, each from a new angle (a different reason, a smaller start, what's getting in the way). On the third silent day ZOH sends the honest day-3 check-in again: sincere, guilt-free, back to her commitment, with the same real choice (keep going, change the plan, or stop and that's fine), but worded clearly differently from the first one. The day after that ZOH sends nothing at all (its texts are paused and the founders flagged). The check-ins may run longer than three sentences.
